dataset.title: Data
dataset.description: Daily AUD exchange rates (RBA table F11.1, from 3 January 2023) or the history of cash rate target decisions (RBA table A2).

currencies.title: Currencies
currencies.description: Three-letter codes for the exchange-rate data, for example USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, NZD, CNY. Add TWI for the trade-weighted index. Leave empty for all currencies the RBA publishes.

latestOnly.title: Latest day only
latestOnly.description: Return only the most recent published day (exchange rates) or the most recent decision (cash rate). Turn off to use the date range below.

dateFrom.title: From date
dateFrom.description: First date to include, as YYYY-MM-DD. Used when Latest day only is off. Blank means 30 days before the newest data.

dateTo.title: To date
dateTo.description: Last date to include, as YYYY-MM-DD. Blank means the newest data.

maxItems.title: Maximum rows
maxItems.description: Safety limit on the number of rows returned in one run.
